186: void Cec_ManCorSetDefaultParams( Cec_ParCor_t * p )
187: {
188:     memset( p, 0, sizeof(Cec_ParCor_t) );
189:     p->nWords         =      15;  // the number of simulation words
190:     p->nRounds        =      15;  // the number of simulation rounds
191:     p->nFrames        =       1;  // the number of time frames
192:     p->nBTLimit       =     100;  // conflict limit at a node
193:     p->nLevelMax      =      -1;  // (scorr only) the max number of levels
194:     p->nStepsMax      =      -1;  // (scorr only) the max number of induction steps
195:     p->nIncrFallbackPct =   100;  // (-i) fall back to full SRM when active pairs exceed this percent
196:     p->nDynSrmRebuildPct =   20;  // (-D) cold-rebuild when active pairs exceed this percent
197:     p->nDynSrmCompactMult =  4;   // (-D) cold-compact when core exceeds this multiple of reset size
198:     p->fLatchCorr     =       0;  // consider only latch outputs
199:     p->fConstCorr     =       0;  // consider only constants
200:     p->fUseRings      =       1;  // combine classes into rings
201:     p->fIncrOracle    =       0;  // unbounded shadow SAT for pairs skipped by -i
202:     p->fSkipFailResim =       0;  // skip resim when a round has no real CEX (only timeout/fail)
203:     p->fDynSrmNoAdapt =       1;  // timing-guided DynSRM rebuild heuristic is opt-in
204:     p->fUseTas        =       0;  // use CBS by default for persistent solving
205:     p->fBmcTasAdaptive =      0;  // guarded BMC TAS rescue is opt-in (-Y)
206:     p->fKissatCert    =       0;  // strict final base+step Kissat audit is opt-in
207:     p->fUseCSat       =       1;  // use circuit-based solver
208: //    p->fFirstStop     =       0;  // stop on the first sat output
209:     p->fUseSmartCnf   =       0;  // use smart CNF computation
210:     p->fVeryVerbose   =       0;  // verbose stats
211:     p->fVerbose       =       0;  // verbose stats
212: }
